## Umbrin Names

## Umbrin Traits
Your Umbrin character has the following racial traits.
**Age.** Although Umbrin mature at the same rate as other elves, few live longer than 300 years.
**Alignment.** Umbrin communities prize survival, loyalty, and individual competence, but no alignment is prescribed by ancestry.
**Size.** Umbrin are similar in size to humans, ranging from 5 to 5½ feet tall. Your size is Medium.
